title: ScroogeFrog AI
summary: AI ad fraud detection that protects your marketing budget
body: ScroogeFrog AI helps advertisers find out where their ad budget is going to waste. It audits website traffic and Google Ads campaigns to uncover suspicious clicks, bot activity, and underperforming spend, then turns complex data into clear recommendations on what to fix. For agencies and larger advertisers, it also offers custom AI fraud detection models trained on their own traffic data. Less guesswork, more control over every advertising dollar.

title: CALL-E
summary: Make phone calls with your AI agent (Muse, ChatGPT, Claude)
body: CALL-E lets your AI assistant make phone calls for you. Ask Muse, ChatGPT or Claude to book a table, get a quote, move an appointment or check stock. CALL-E asks for anything missing, shows you the plan, and dials a real US or Canadian number after you confirm. It gets through phone menus, hold and voicemail, then brings back a summary, the transcript and what happened. Builders can add it to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenClaw with one prompt. New users get 100 free credits.

title: Scribe v3 by ElevenLabs
summary: Speech to text with 27% fewer errors in 90+ languages
body: Scribe v3 is ElevenLabs’ most accurate speech-to-text model, for developers building on calls, meetings, interviews and media. It makes 27% fewer word errors than Scribe v2 across 90+ languages. Unlike transcription that breaks on noise, accents and crosstalk, it labels up to 32 speakers, tags laughter, music and emotion, boosts up to 1,000 of your own terms, detects 56 entity types and handles files up to 15 hours. For live use, Scribe v3 Live runs under 150ms.

title: Relay
summary: DocSend for AI agents: send and receive docs with context
body: You send a deck or doc. They ask their AI to read it. The AI sees what's on the page, but not the thinking behind it: why you made those choices, what you left out, or what's still open. Relay shares that context with your document, so they and their AI can understand it and ask questions. You choose what to share. Decisions that need your input, like a discount or a date, come back to you. Try a sample relay. No sign-up needed.

title: Shot.video

Scan a QR code and a phone becomes another camera, with no app to install. Press record once. Every angle records in sync, then AI makes your first edit. It cuts to the camera you're looking at and adds zooms, punch-ins and optional B-roll. Change anything you like. Free to start. No card needed.

body:
Gemini Decisions API

Google join Jev and OpenAI in the decision model category with "Gemini Decision 1". This new model API is almost identical to Jev: it supports the same three types of questions (yes/no, choice, and rubric-scoring) and even reuses Jev's term "Noul" for a yes/no question.

It's priced the same as the GPT-6 Luna decision model: 10 cents per million input tokens, and output is free. Jev remains the cheapest of the three, at 4.2 cents per million.

Jev is text (and JSON) only. OpenAI can handle text and images.
